import json, subprocess, sys, zlib

def rec(seq, kind, tid, payload=b"", crc_ok=True):
    h = len(payload).to_bytes(4,'little') + seq.to_bytes(4,'little') + bytes([kind]) + tid.to_bytes(4,'little')
    c = zlib.crc32(h+payload) & 0xffffffff
    if not crc_ok:
        c ^= 0xFFFFFFFF
    return h + payload + c.to_bytes(4,'little')

def ppatch(page, off, data):
    return page.to_bytes(2,'little') + off.to_bytes(2,'little') + len(data).to_bytes(2,'little') + data

def pcommit(count, digest):
    return count.to_bytes(4,'little') + digest.to_bytes(4,'little')

def dg(payloads):
    c = 0
    for p in payloads:
        c = zlib.crc32(p, c)
    return c & 0xffffffff

def run(cases):
    inp = "".join(json.dumps(c[0])+"\n" for c in cases)

    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    lines = p.stdout.splitlines()
    assert len(lines) == len(cases), (len(lines), len(cases), p.stdout)
    ok = True

            ok = False
            print(f"FAIL case {i}: {req}")
            print(f"  exp {exp}")
            print(f"  got {got}")
    return ok

import json, struct, subprocess, sys, time, zlib

def rec(seq, kind, tid, payload=b""):
    h = struct.pack("<IIBI", len(payload), seq, kind, tid)
    return h + payload + struct.pack("<I", zlib.crc32(h+payload))

def ppatch(page, off, data):
    return struct.pack("<HHH", page, off, len(data)) + data

# dense log: as many small records as fit in 64 KiB
log = b""
seq = 0
while len(log) + 17 <= 65536:
    seq += 1
    log += rec(seq, 1 if seq % 2 else 4, (seq % 7) + 1)
# a log with max-size payloads
big = b""
payload = ppatch(0, 0, b"\x00" * 64).ljust(4096, b"\x00")  # will be invalid shape (len != 6+count) -> stops; use valid instead
seq = 0
big = b""
while len(big) + 13 + 75 + 4 <= 65536:
    seq += 1
    p = ppatch(0, 0, bytes(69))
    big += rec(seq, 1, 1) if seq % 3 == 1 else rec(seq, 2, 1, p)
print("dense log bytes:", len(log), "records:", seq)

reqs = []
for i in range(300):
    reqs.append({"pages": ["00"*64]*8, "checkpoint": i, "log": log.hex()})
    reqs.append({"pages": ["00"*64]*8, "checkpoint": i, "log": big.hex()})
inp = "".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs)
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/main.py"], input=inp, text=True, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("exit", p.returncode, "lines", len(p.stdout.splitlines()), "time %.2fs" % dt)
assert p.returncode == 0 and len(p.stdout.splitlines()) == len(reqs)
